name: never_told
title: Repeats only what it was told
why: Three facts go in. The probes then ask about adjacent things nobody ever said: salary, marital status, a manager. A memory system built on extraction can enrich its way into asserting them; a witness may only repeat testimony. The retention probes catch the trivial cheat of remembering nothing at all.
